title: Nude Descending a Staircase (No. 3)
summary: Duchamp froze the descent into one permanent picture; the browser's View Transition API paints every in-between frame and discards it.
mechanism: document.startViewTransition() interpolates unauthored frames between two figure poses; a rAF proxy counts them, none are kept, stored, or sent.
references: Marcel Duchamp, Nude Descending a Staircase, No. 2 (1912)
